title: QE Archive run writes never populate archived_at
description: Expected: every successful QE Archive confirmed write stamps qe_archive.run.archived_at with the actual archive/write timestamp and preserves any existing non-null archived_at during re-upsert. Actual: diagnosis on qe_20260520_133940_fdb2 showed 8 archived loop runs with completed ingest_history rows, but all 8 qe_archive.run.archived_at values were NULL; full-table diagnosis showed archived_at_present=0.
reproduce_command: Inspect qe_archive.run after manual/backfill ingestion for qe_20260520_133940_fdb2 or run SELECT count(*) total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE archived_at IS NULL) archived_at_null FROM qe_archive.run; observe every archived run has archived_at=NULL even though ingest_history is completed.
required_verification: frontend targeted typecheck/tests for changed QE Archive pages
closure_requirements: New archive writes populate qe_archive.run.archived_at with archive/write timestamp.
Re-upsert preserves existing non-null archived_at when incoming payload has NULL.
Regression tests cover archived_at creation and preservation.
GitHub issue #138 and BUG-094 registry record are updated with branch, commit, and validation evidence.

events.note: Mirrored manually to GitHub issue #138 via gh CLI because Validation MCP live GitHub creation lacks GITHUB_REPOSITORY in this session and local registry search is blocked by a BOM parse error in another BUG JSON.
